release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.14 improves all-in showdown presentation. After an all-in runout is chosen, all live opponents' hole cards are revealed while folded hands remain hidden. Run It Twice now reveals Board 1 flop, turn and river in sequence, then Board 2 flop, turn and river, using the existing card-flip animations and street sounds. Future cards stay face-down until their street, runout progress survives switching tables, and pot payout animation waits until the runout is fully revealed. The immutable 174-situation preflop chart is unchanged.
